bio.short: I help businesses replace manual, error-prone workflows with reporting systems that actually get used — Automated Excel Systems delivered as branded Ribbon add-ins, and Custom Web Applications hosted on your own domain. Both ship with documented SOPs and 30–45 days of post-delivery support.
long: Most businesses don't have a data problem. They have a clarity problem. MIS reports get stitched together by hand every month, formulas get patched, field teams WhatsApp their daily reports into a group chat, and one day nobody trusts the numbers anymore. That's what Altorz fixes.

I'm the founder of Altorz — a boutique reporting systems consultancy for businesses. Altorz ships in two mediums: Automated Excel Systems delivered as the branded Altorz Ribbon™, and Custom Web Applications hosted on your own domain. Both come with documented SOPs so your team can run them without me.

By day I run data and operations for a B2B manufacturing firm — which is exactly how I learned, firsthand, how broken business workflows cripple real companies. By evening and weekend, I rebuild them for Altorz clients. I work to one rule: production-grade, not prototype-grade.
